notes.title: The Green New Deal Simulator is Out Now!
notes.content:
Same universe, same practical utopianism, same talking animals... completely new gameplay! The Green New Deal Simulator is a casual card-driven game about the energy transition in the United States. Become the secretary of the Green New Deal and balance emission reduction and employment before the effects of climate change become irreversible.
100% free for Windows, Mac on Steam, iOS and Android.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2334990/Green_New_Deal_Simulator/]Get it now from Steam[/url]
